scope: recovery after AKO-125 and AKO-126; before AKO-127

interpretation.confirmedBottleneck: gateway archive upload remains dominant after private authentication probes fail
interpretation.barrierAccounting: each shared barrier and merge is one joint operation, not a sum across predecessor records
interpretation.credentialDefect: OpenSSH expiry-time rejects the T-separated timestamp; isolated real sshd accepts the corrected continuous UTC timestamp, enforces the forced command and rejects expired authorization
interpretation.identityCompatibilityDefect: the gateway container client reads PKCS8 Ed25519 but the host OpenSSH client rejects it; canonical OpenSSH private-key serialization is used instead and verified against the matching public key
interpretation.productionCausalityLimitation: production probe stderr was not persisted; the credential defect is confirmed but cannot yet be asserted as the sole cause of those production probes
interpretation.response: cancel recovery, preserve reusable completed workspaces, stop idle VMs and correct/test before recovery
interpretation.comparisonLimitation: recovery and simultaneous transfers contaminate makespan and gateway throughput; this is not an uninterrupted benchmark
